title: Scheduled rules
help: Select a rule and review a fresh preview to enable or change its schedule. Disabling stops future runs; an existing job remains available in history.
policy: Runs require this active login session (8 hours by default, configurable by your administrator). Logout, session expiry or restart requires a new approval. Each run checks current permissions and previews the approved rule again. Rule or collection changes require approval. Missed runs are skipped; failures appear here. No automatic retry of failed writes.
consent: I approve unattended writes by this rule revision, including future documents matching its filter, at the chosen recurrence. I have reviewed the operations and any clearing of values.
approved: Schedule approved. The first run will start at its next scheduled time.
failure: A scheduled run needs attention. Review its history before re-enabling if paused.
